pageTitle: Naura Meets — random meetings with non-random people
metaDescription: A service for meetings within communities and by interests. Expand your circle, find your people, get new ideas through regular meetings with interesting people.

how.headline: How meetings work
how.description: Naura Meets is a format of regular meetings with new people. Every week you decide whether to participate or skip. If you participate, we match you and provide context so the conversation doesn't start from scratch.

cards.title: Context before meeting
cards.description: See the participant's profile: what they do, what they're looking for, how they can help

cards.title: Rhythm without pressure
cards.description: You decide each time — participate or not. No pressure, your pace.

cards.title: Protection from empty meetings
cards.description: If you don't connect, we'll find a new match. After the meeting — feedback that we take into account next time

why.eyebrow: What outcome should we get from meetings?
why.headline: What's the magic of two strangers meeting, who have something to discuss?
why.note: Every week — one new person and a conversation that doesn't start from scratch. Matching, context and feedback are built in — the format runs itself.

communities.eyebrow: Host your meetings in the Naura space
communities.note: Participants get to know each other, newcomers integrate faster, activity grows along with community value — without your participation.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Participants come to events but don't know each other. Newcomers get lost. Between meetings — silence. All this eats up engagement, and the community remains formal.

solution.title: Solution
solution.description: Naura Meets launches regular 1-on-1 meetings within your community. People meet themselves, you get a tool that works on autopilot.

items.question: What if the match doesn't suit me?
items.answer: If you haven't connected by Wednesday, we'll find a new match. After the meeting, leave feedback, we'll take it into account next time.

items.question: Can I choose who to meet with?
items.answer: No, the magic of Meets is in randomness! At the same time, we take into account the profile context (sphere, interests, goals) to select the most interesting interlocutors.

items.question: How often do I need to participate?
items.answer: Every week you receive an invitation — decide for yourself. Skip a round — nothing happens, return when convenient.

items.question: How long does launch take?
items.answer: Setup — 10 minutes. Then everything works automatically.

items.question: Can I limit participants?
items.answer: Yes, configure access by groups, meeting format, round frequency.

items.question: What if participants don't meet?
items.answer: We monitor this: check-in in the middle of the week, possibility of replacing a pair, feedback after the round. You see the statistics.
